title: Sable and the Archive
author: Rosalind Underhill
blurb: Felix Joubert, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
